dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast white spotting on the edges of dark flight feathers, creating a clear, sharp boundary.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct white rectangular/oval patch located on the upper nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp linear transition from the red crown plumage to the white nape patch and grey mantle.
